title: Tesseract by Mirage: 'Help your agent escape' prompt-driven world-hop
summary: AI-video product promo for Tesseract (Mirage): a stylised white-haired heroine escapes a concrete cave and hops through worlds (utopian solarpunk, wireframe grid, comic-book sunset rooftop, hoverboard, Tron-like cyber city) while a chat-style prompt bar at the bottom types each edit command ('use a vector mask to cut an opening', 'Roto her out', 'Speed ramp into slow motion'). Retro terminal dialogs and a CRT end card frame it as a game; one continuous take with almost no hard cuts.
fit_reason: The 'typed prompt drives the scene' device is a smart way to show a tool working, but the cinematic AI-character world needs heavy AI video and is off-brand for B2B portals.

palette.mood: dark cinematic with cyan HUD; shifts per world (stone grey, warm sunset, cyber blue)

typography.display: retro monospace / pixel terminal type for dialogs and prompts; red pixel font for 'YOU WIN'; clean sans for end logo
typography.size_behaviour: small UI-size prompts at bottom; mid-size dialog text; big pixel 'YOU WIN'
typography.notes: Prompt bar = dark rounded pill bottom-centre, ~45% width, mono light-grey text, cyan circular send button right; small 'Made with Tesseract' watermark bottom-right in green mono.

text_animation: typewriter typing in prompt bar, char by char, then cursor-click on send
terminal dialog box pops in with cyan header bar
captions: none (the prompt bar acts as on-screen narration)
motion: keyframe path curve overlay drawn over scene
transitions: vector-mask hole reveals next world (portal cut-through)
roto composite: character stays, world swaps behind
camera zoom-out to CRT monitor end card
graphic_elements: retro OS dialogs with cyan buttons
ui_treatment: rebuilt minimal UI overlays (prompt bar, terminal dialogs, graph editor) composited onto AI footage

pacing.hold_time_s: 4-6 s per world, one continuous shot

sound.sfx: UI clicks, glitch, whooshes on world swaps
sound.sync: world changes timed to prompt send

signature_moves: typed prompt command -> scene obeys it
character constant while world swaps behind (roto composite)
retro game framing: dialog box start, 'YOU WIN' end, CRT logo card

best_segments.what: prompt bar types 'use a vector mask to cut an opening' and the character reacts in the stone room

recreate.how: Needs AI video for the character worlds (Higgsfield/Seedance image-to-video with one consistent character), then HTML/Remotion overlay for prompt bar typewriter, dialogs and keyframe graph; composite in ffmpeg.
recreate.prompt: Single continuous shot, a stylised character walks through changing worlds; bottom chat prompt bar types the edit command before each world change; cyan HUD dialogs, retro terminal font, CRT monitor end card.
